paper_anchor: Definition 4.1; LaTeX label def:reg_mixing_time; ar5iv S4.Thmtheorem1
exact_statement: tau_delta = min{t in N_0: m rho^t <= delta}, delta in (0,1), under sup_mu0 d_TV(P_pi^t mu_0, mu_pi) <= m rho^t for all t in N_0
domain: finite irreducible aperiodic Markov chains with m>0 and rho in (0,1)
machine_contract: Exhaust every point-mass initial distribution on the predeclared refresh-chain grid and require direct worst-case TV first crossing to equal the definition
pass_condition: 60/60 rows agree, 12/12 assumption audits pass, and tau+1 is rejected on 60/60 rows
